name: malicious-service-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): installs a REAL, running Windows service (the systemd-service analog). Writes a PowerShell payload ($PAYLOAD_PATH/$PAYLOAD_BODY), creates service $SERVICE_NAME with BinaryPathName launching that payload via powershell.exe, sets failure recovery to auto-restart, and starts it. Vars: SERVICE_NAME (required, no spaces); DESCRIPTION (optional); PAYLOAD_PATH (required); PAYLOAD_BODY (optional, a long-running script); STARTUP (optional, default Automatic). Idempotent: recreates the service if the name is taken.
